BLAKE3 hashing, XOF, and LtHash routines with SIMD batch support.

# Purpose
This file implements the `fd_blake3` hashing engine. It provides the state machine that builds a BLAKE3 hash tree from input data, manages leaf and branch compression, and finishes the hash into a 32 byte digest. The code also supports an XOF-style finish path used to expand the root hash into a 2048 byte `LtHash` output. The main public entry points are [`fd_blake3_new`](<#fd_blake3_new>), [`fd_blake3_join`](<#fd_blake3_join>), [`fd_blake3_leave`](<#fd_blake3_leave>), [`fd_blake3_delete`](<#fd_blake3_delete>), [`fd_blake3_init`](<#fd_blake3_init>), [`fd_blake3_append`](<#fd_blake3_append>), [`fd_blake3_fini`](<#fd_blake3_fini>), [`fd_blake3_hash`](<#fd_blake3_hash>), and [`fd_blake3_fini_2048`](<#fd_blake3_fini_2048>).

The file also contains the internal scheduler that decides when to hash leaf chunks and when to merge branch nodes. It uses a buffer tree in `fd_blake3_buf_t`, a position state in `fd_blake3_pos_t`, and optional SIMD paths for AVX, AVX512, and SSE. When parallel support is enabled, it can batch several compression operations at once with [`fd_blake3_batch_hash`](<#fd_blake3_batch_hash>) and the [`fd_blake3_lthash_batch8`](<#fd_blake3_lthash_batch8>) and [`fd_blake3_lthash_batch16`](<#fd_blake3_lthash_batch16>) helpers.
